category_description: How income tax, GST and capital gains tax work in Australia.
subcategory_description: Repaying HELP and other study and training loans.
label: Repayment income where compulsory repayments start
context: Compulsory repayments on HELP and other study and training loans are nil up to and including this repayment income.

label: Repayment rate on income above the minimum, first band
context: Charged on each dollar of repayment income above the minimum, up to the top of the first band. Only the income above the minimum is counted.

label: Repayment income where the first repayment band ends
context: Above this the repayment is a fixed amount plus a higher rate on each dollar over this level.

label: Fixed repayment at the top of the first band
context: The repayment on repayment income of exactly the top of the first band, and the fixed part of the repayment in the second band.

label: Repayment rate on income above the first band
context: Charged on each dollar of repayment income above the top of the first band, up to the top of the second band, on top of the fixed amount.

label: Repayment income where the second repayment band ends
context: Above this the repayment is a percentage of the whole of the repayment income.

label: Repayment rate on total repayment income at the top
context: Charged on the whole repayment income, not only the part above a threshold, from one dollar above the second band.
